title: HSK 3.0 (2025) — Level 1, Level 2 and Level 3 Learning Path
description: Practise foundational Mandarin through complete thematic lessons covering all 300 Level 1, 200 Level 2 and 500 Level 3 vocabulary entries, with conversations, grammar, reading, speaking and progress checkpoints.

sections.title: HSK 3.0 Level 1 — Foundation
sections.description: A proposed thematic learning path for the 300 entries in the user-supplied Level 1 vocabulary dataset; not an official sequence.

sections.title: HSK 3.0 Level 3 — Everyday Fluency
sections.description: 35 thematic lessons introducing all 500 HSK 3.0 Level 3 entries (official IDs 501–1000) across all 22 taxonomy topics.
